artifacts.summary: Nine-phase plan covering all nine defect items plus the live typst-sync-check blocker, sequenced in five dependency waves with per-phase verification tiers and scope hypotheses.

memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, editing any .lean file -- even a docstring-only change -- shifts FormalSystem/ and Tests/ line counts, which typst/generated/status.typ records and scripts/typst-sync-check.sh Check 2 polices against a live regeneration. Any plan that mixes Lean edits with typst work must therefore place all Lean edits in a single phase and end that phase by re-running scripts/typst-status-counts.sh and committing the regenerated typst/generated/status.typ, or every later phase's sync-check verification fails for a reason unrelated to its own work. This is a real cross-domain phase-ordering constraint, not a cosmetic one.
